尽管减小金属厚度会使容器 -- 变轻，但其强度也会因此下降。
A. repeatedly
B. regardlessly
C. decreasingly
D. considerably

items.question: Although a reduction in metal thickness would make the container--___ lighter, its strength would suffer as a result.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“considerably”代入题干后为“Although a reduction in metal thickness would make the containerconsiderably lighter, its strength would suffer as a result.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：D（considerably）。
